Why Asking Questions Is So Important
1. Am I a Good Candidate for This Procedure?

Red Flags to Watch Out for Before Cosmetic Surgery

2. No Discussion About Risks
3. Pressure to Make an Immediate Decision
4. Poor Communication
5. Inadequate Facility Standards
6. Lack of Personalized Treatment Planning
